apply_note: Executable payload exists but the runner scope for this worker is read-restricted: no settings GET, no GET versions/{id}, ever (also on error paths). Pre-apply verification relies on deployments list + versions list only.

active_deployment.assert: result.deployments[0].id === pinned_live_deployment_id AND its versions[0].version_id === pinned_live_version_id; mismatch -> STOP (stale pin).

latest_upload.assert: the newest version id in the versions list === pinned_live_version_id AND the total count equals the pinned snapshot count; any extra/unpublished version -> STOP.

full_settings.reason: settings GET is a forbidden read for this worker; only the frozen snapshot inventory is pinned.
full_settings.binding_drift_safety_note: Live binding drift is NOT verifiable (settings GET forbidden). bindings_inherit=strict makes the PUT fail (10057) if any inherit-resolvable binding changed; an unexpected extra live binding is NOT covered by strict-inherit and would be silently replaced by the explicit binding list. Accept only after a separate reviewed decision.

post_deploy_readback.settings_get: FORBIDDEN for this worker (plain_text bindings possible); binding verification is NOT possible — see binding_drift_safety_note
post_deploy_readback.abort_rule: Active deployment must reference the new version id from the PUT response. If a FOREIGN version is active -> STOP. Settings deviations (riot/steam) -> STOP + rollback payload for this worker.

function_smoke: Follow docs/cloudflare-write-plan.md W1 function tests for this worker after operator apply.
